newsitem.title: CHINA: Group signs $240 mln loan for China power plant.
newsitem.headline: Group signs $240 mln loan for China power plant.

text.p: A group of Chinese and foreign financial institutions has signed an agreement to extend a $240 million loan to a south China power plant, an official of the Guangzhou branch of the Bank of China said on Friday.
The group of 29 financial institutions includes the Bank of China's Guangzhou branch, Societe Generale Asia Ltd and Kincheng Finance Hong Kong Ltd, the official told Reuters.

Zhujiang thermal power plant in the south China city of Guangzhou is the borrower of the five-year loan which can be extended by three more years, the official said. He declined to give the interest rate or provide further details.
The loan would be used to finance construction of the second phase of the plant, an official of the power plant said. The plant would have four 300-megawatt generators on completion.
